description: This file defines a React component called 'Timeline' used for visualizing trace data in a timeline view. It manages various timeline elements such as actions, resources, console messages, and supports interactions like selecting, resizing, and moving time windows, as well as rendering a film strip preview.

methods.name: calculateDividerOffsets
methods.description: Calculates positions and labels for timeline dividers based on the current boundaries and client width.

methods.name: timeToPosition
methods.description: Converts a timestamp to a pixel position within the timeline UI based on current boundaries and width.

methods.name: positionToTime
methods.description: Converts a pixel position within the timeline UI to a timestamp based on current boundaries and width.

methods.name: barTop
methods.description: Returns the top offset (in pixels) for a timeline bar based on its type.
